pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Medium-sized polygonal patches with rounded vertices and smooth edge gradients. Spatial distribution is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, with patches becoming smaller and more elongated along the upper neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected cream-colored negative space forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily 3-way and 4-way intersections. Pathway thickness is consistent across the central flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a fine-textured, low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette extending along the upper neck and shoulder line.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple avian symbionts (oxpeckers) are visible on the dorsal ridge and lower posterior flank, creating localized occlusions of the pelage pattern.
